entities.summary: Greater Romania's democratic experiment, the rise of Corneliu Zelea Codreanu's fascist Iron Guard (Legion of the Archangel Michael), King Carol II's personal dictatorship (1938), and the catastrophic territorial losses of 1940 (Bessarabia, Northern Transylvania, Southern Dobruja).
